eval.description: Google DeepMind lab-internal agentic CTF suite for offensive cyber key skills (reconnaissance, tool development, tool usage, and operational security), grounded in the Rodriguez et al. attack-chain framework. v1 maps bottleneck tasks to easy, medium, and hard difficulty; v2 adds harder end-to-end multi-stage challenges. A challenge counts as solved if any attempt captures the flag; cards report solves by difficulty and version.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents use offensive cyber skills such as reconnaissance, tool development, and stealth in capture-the-flag tasks.
